desc: Derive the group wrap update: for value v, delta = 2*sum_positions[v] - count[v]*(N+1); equal-value pairs cancel.
Implement initial inversion counting with a Fenwick tree in O(N log M).
Precompute each value's occurrence count and sum of 1-based positions for transition updates.
Verify duplicate values are excluded correctly by the group-level delta.
Produce and validate an O(N log M + N + M) Python stdin/stdout solution.
